seasons.name: Winter
seasons.description: Cold weather, long nights, and quieter roads as people stay close to shelter and heat.

timeDescriptions.description: Deep night with minimal natural light.
Muted dawn light begins to lift the darkness.
Cold daylight with clear visibility.
Late afternoon light fades quickly.
Night returns with poor visibility.

seasons.name: Spring
seasons.description: Mild rain, fresh growth, and renewed travel as markets and communities become busier.

timeDescriptions.description: Nighttime conditions with limited natural light.
Early dawn as the sky brightens.
Bright daytime light with good visibility.
Evening light is fading toward dusk.
Night settles in and visibility drops.

seasons.name: Summer
seasons.description: Warm to hot days, high activity, and long daylight hours favorable to travel and work.

timeDescriptions.description: Short midsummer night with low visibility.
Early dawn light spreads across the horizon.
Strong daylight with excellent visibility.
Long evening light starts to soften.
Late twilight transitions into night.

seasons.name: Autumn
seasons.description: Cooling air, harvest routines, and shorter days as settlements prepare for winter.

timeDescriptions.description: Dark overnight conditions with low visibility.
Cool dawn light grows across the landscape.
Clear daytime light suitable for travel and work.
Dusk arrives as daylight recedes.
Nightfall with reduced natural visibility.

holidays.name: New Year's Day
holidays.description: The first day of the year, marked by resolutions, public gatherings, and ceremonial toasts.

holidays.name: Deep Winter Vigil
holidays.description: A night of lanterns and shared fires held to endure the harshest stretch of winter.

holidays.name: Vernal Eve
holidays.description: A celebration of spring's arrival with planting rites and bright decorations.

holidays.name: Founders' Day
holidays.description: Communities honor their origins with speeches, local histories, and civic festivals.

holidays.name: Midspring Fair
holidays.description: Trade stalls, games, and performances draw crowds for a week of commerce and leisure.

holidays.name: High Sun Festival
holidays.description: The longest-day celebration features outdoor feasts, competitions, and music.

holidays.name: Harvest Oath
holidays.description: Farmers and merchants mark the main harvest with vows, contracts, and gratitude rites.

holidays.name: Remembering Night
holidays.description: People honor the dead and absent with quiet offerings, stories, and candlelit walks.

holidays.name: First Frost Market
holidays.description: A seasonal market opens as cold weather settles in, focusing on storage goods and winter wares.

holidays.name: Year's End
holidays.description: The final day of the year is kept with reflection, debts settled, and midnight celebrations.
